stem: A 7-year-old child has frequent eye blinking and throat clearing every day for 14 months; what is the most appropriate diagnosis?
explanation: Tourette's syndrome is the correct diagnosis because it involves both motor and vocal tics persisting for more than one year.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because provisional tic disorder lasts less than one year and this child has symptoms for 14 months.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because persistent motor tic disorder involves motor tics only, whereas this child has both motor and vocal tics.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because Tourette's syndrome is defined by both motor and vocal tics lasting more than one year.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because stereotypic movements are repetitive, patterned behaviours that are not tics.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because functional neurological disorder does not best explain a typical history of chronic motor and vocal tics.

source.hint: Consider the combination of different types of ticks (motor and vocal) and the total duration of the symptoms.
